title: 5.12.1 Sub-build: Score once per pipe
description: A pipe crosses the bird. Count it once, however many frames the bird is beside it.

steps.title: Run it first
steps.instructions: Pipes cross. The score stays at 0: nothing counts them.

steps.title: Remember it was counted
steps.instructions: On every pipe, keep a flag that starts false. When the bird's x passes the pipe's x and the flag is still false, add 1 and set the flag to true.
hints: A flag on the pipe itself is enough: `p.passed`.
Compare positions (`bird.x > p.x`), not touching: the bird is beside a pipe for many frames.

steps.title: Prove it counts once
steps.instructions: Run it. Each pipe should add exactly 1, not one per frame while the bird is beside it.
hints: A score that climbs by 60 a second means the flag is missing or never set.

requirements.title: The pass is detected
requirements.description: The bird's x is compared with a pipe's x, in a loop over the pipes. Help: 5.11.3 (Lab: Pipes that come and go)

requirements.title: Counted once
requirements.description: A per-pipe flag is set after counting, so the same pipe cannot score twice. Help: 5.11.3 (Lab: Pipes that come and go)

aiCheck.rubricTitle: What the AI read in your code
aiCheck.prompt: The student wrote a short moSHion sketch for "Sub-build: Score once per pipe". The task: in a loop over the pipes, compare the bird's x with each pipe's x, add 1 to the score only when the pipe has not been counted, and mark that pipe as counted. This is a sub-build: a small isolated program whose only job is this one mechanic. Accept any names, helpers, arrow functions and ternaries. A line only in a comment or string does not count. Use short, plain notes for a 14-year-old, name their own line when something is missing, never write corrected code.

rubric.title: Position, not touching
rubric.description: The pass is detected by comparing x positions, not by a collision.

rubric.title: One point per pipe
rubric.description: A flag on the pipe is checked before scoring and set after, so each pipe scores once.

rubric.title: Inside the loop
rubric.description: The check runs for every pipe in the array, not once for the first.
